aquamirae_nouveau.description.armor_shat: Apply Aquamirae armor shatter for 12 seconds. Each successful activation adds one level, up to five; Amplify adds levels. Each level reduces armor by 10%.
ars_nouveau.augment_desc.glyph_armor_sha: Add effect levels up to the native limit.
aquamirae_nouveau.description.health_sha: Apply Aquamirae health shatter for 12 seconds. Each successful activation adds one level, up to ten; Amplify adds levels. Each level reduces maximum health by 5%. This does not heal the target when it expires.
ars_nouveau.augment_desc.glyph_health_sh: Add effect levels up to the native limit.
aquamirae_nouveau.description.fury_of_th: Apply Aquamirae Fury of the Depths for 30 seconds. Each level adds 10% to the native Depths Fury attribute, up to five levels. Native combat and equipment rules determine its damage benefits.
ars_nouveau.augment_desc.glyph_fury_of_t: Add effect levels up to the native limit.
aquamirae_nouveau.description.resilience: Apply Aquamirae Resilience of the Depths for 30 seconds. Each level adds 10% to the native Depths Resilience attribute, up to five levels. Native combat and equipment rules determine protection.
ars_nouveau.augment_desc.glyph_resilienc: Add effect levels up to the native limit.
aquamirae_nouveau.description.abyssal_sh: NeoForge only: launch a native homing shard at the trigger position along the incoming direction. It targets monsters or mobs attacking its owner, inflicts Weakness and splits on breaking. Amplify raises native scale by 0.2, capped at 2. Subsequent Ars effects stay at the original trigger, not the shard hit.
ars_nouveau.augment_desc.glyph_abyssal_s: Increase native shard scale and damage.
